task: Generate an entirely withheld HDL cholesterol column conditional on observed BMI, age and sex using independently retrieved external primary literature.
case: NHANES 2013-2014 HDL; metadata/accessibility selected before outcome analysis
review_policy: Both arms receive the same source/code/scientific-review rubric and may retrieve and revise within remaining budget. Gap-policy arm additionally executes its explicit consequential-gap/action contract.
primary_comparison: All locked scientific analyses on every final construction, regardless of the Agent's support labels. Initial-to-final changes are secondary process diagnostics.
primary_endpoint: Adjusted BMI association with raw HDL, per 5 kg/m^2, interpreted with reference uncertainty; no desired sign supplied to builders.
success_definition: Report scientific interpretation agreement/disagreement and estimates for all locked endpoints. Do not require exact values, use significance matching as universal success, or choose a favorable draw. No arbitrary aggregate success threshold or superiority test with two builds per arm.
generated_data_objective: Generated analytical usefulness is separate from support-label accuracy, qualification and abstention.
model_choice: Agent-owned. No biological coefficients, relationship directions, mandatory nonlinear terms, interaction effects, or noise scales in the execution controller.
model_runtime: Agent-authored Python using numpy, pandas and scipy; direct records remain in broader scope but this pilot isolates the decision policy using the executable route.
model_identity: Fresh collaboration agents inheriting the same parent configuration; exact provider revision and token accounting may be unavailable and will not be invented.
budget_limitations: Equal caps and interaction schedules do not guarantee equal actual reasoning tokens; record observable search/download counts, artifact changes, turns and wall time. An additional review is not free treatment compute.
blinding: Fresh contexts and explicit file scopes, screened literature interface, no evaluator feedback before every construction is frozen. Shared desktop filesystem means procedural isolation, not an OS sandbox or perfect pretraining isolation.
source_exclusions: Any NHANES-derived outcome evidence, participant records or published target analyses from any cycle; screen aliases before display. Source screening is conservative and imperfect.
forbidden_feedback: Target HDL values, target outcome summaries, target scientific analysis results, previous arm models/results, or another builder's evidence/decisions.
evaluation_release: Only after all four final candidates and all scheduled initial/final generated datasets are frozen and integrity-checked.
reporting: Retain failures, no-ops, all builds/draws and protocol deviations. Synthetic rows are not independent method replications. Never tune to revealed target answers.
interpretation: A small implementation and feasibility pilot, not confirmatory method superiority, patient-level recovery, causal discovery or replacement of real measurements.
